publicHolidayPolicy.note: Council states day-of-week signs do not apply on the public holiday AND on any declared day in lieu.

signConventions.permitException: Signs read 'AREA # RESIDENT PERMIT EXCEPTED' or 'PERMIT ZONE AREA #'. Permit areas are codes like 1, 1A, 7, 12.
signConventions.paidParking: Green 'P' signs with 'TICKET' or 'METER'; pay via meter, ticket machine or PayStay app. Fee applies only during the signed hours.
signConventions.clearways: Arterial roads carry CLEARWAY with peak-hour windows; vehicles are towed.
signConventions.disabilityPermits: Accessible Parking Permit holders get double the signed time in green-signed bays.

publicHolidayPolicy.note: Yarra: holiday rules apply on the public holiday only, not a day in lieu.
Unknown council: engine treats both the holiday and any substitute day as a holiday but lowers confidence.
